description: A CDN "stylesheet" answers 200 with an HTML page (soft 404).

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on another host (CDN / third party) is skipped with one logSafe'd warning and the job succeeds. A text/html or application/xhtml+xml stylesheet response is rejected (soft 404). The css parse error that empties the sheet in critical gives the same joined css as a skipped sheet except for one extra empty element in the join, see expected-thin.css. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: the stylesheet same-host rule compares hostname:port with the scheme ignored, the notion the url() rebasing uses.)
